answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use ferrous economic slashing: every identity locks a small deposit that decays only when the agent misbehaves, so trust becomes sable-hard, earned slowly through validated work. A fake operator spinning up thousands of clones must fund each deposit upfront, and their sonnet-perfect profiles cannot fake transaction history; one attack drains all cloned stakes at once, making bulk forgery more expensive than honest participation.
